usr_e15818a7-2b97-41de-b875-1effcb52f04e.letter:
Dear Marta,

I am really glad you reached out. When I sit with what you shared about feeling stuck and carrying this friction day-to-day, a very clear and unmistakable pattern stands out.

Right now, beneath the surface of the daily rush, you are caught in a cycle where your natural impulse to move forward is being interrupted before it ever gets to land. You have the desire, and in your mind you know where things need to go, but right at the moment where thought should turn into clear, unburdened momentum, an invisible brake gets pulled.

What this is costing you is not just time—it is costing you your trust in your own pacing. When you hesitate, it is rarely because you lack the capability; it is because an old habit of second-guessing or over-absorbing outside friction is draining your tank before you even begin. 

If you would like an even deeper reading, I can analyze your birth chart alongside the current moment's energy. Just share your birth date, time, and city, or upload a chart image if you have one. But if you would prefer to keep it to what is happening right now, that works perfectly too.


I've identified exactly which Bach Flower essences would support you through this specific pattern. To get your personalized blend formula, you can unlock it for $3.49, or get 3 blend formulas for $7.99 if you'd like to explore different situations over time.

Finding Your Remedies:
You can also order custom blends online with direct delivery from trusted makers like Nelsons Bach (nelsonsnatural.com), Healing Herbs (healingherbs.co.uk), or Bach Flower Remedies (bachflower.com).

Take a deep breath and give yourself some grace today. You are already doing the real work simply by paying attention to what needs to shift.

Warmly,
Your Consultant
